notes.title: The Swapful Update
notes.notes:
New traits and new events galore!
In this Paper Pirates update, we're adding seven new traits, including one exclusive to games that make use of the Crew's Choice event selection method, and five new events to help ensure that every voyage is completely unique.

New Trait: The Acrobats
The Acrobats is a new active trait for both Trait and Trait+ games. The Acrobats appear as a pair, and on a day when either of The Acrobats doesn't play in, they can choose to trade their rank on the ship with each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/92e42d7663f9e6c00ea6383340b40aa227595921.png
There's no limit to the amount of times The Acrobats can activate their trait, so they can continue swapping back and forth as long as they're not in a job. How will the power struggle of The Acrobats change the team dynamics on the ship?

New Trait: The Watcher
The Watcher is a new active trait for both Trait and Trait+ games. On Day One, The Watcher may choose any other pirate from the crew. Any time that pirate plays in, The Watcher will be informed whether they chose to obey or disobey the job.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b28ad3a447f722d962a30021a9e9e609335f9a25.png
When The Watcher doesn't play in, they may choose to change which pirate they're watching. Like The Protector, they may choose to watch a different pirate as many times as they choose. They can even watch the captain!

New Trait: The Clairvoyant
The Clairvoyant is a new active trait for both Trait and Trait+ games. On days when The Clairvoyant does not play in, they may activate their trait to privately and secretly check how many pirates are currently on the ghost team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b7a8de7b21563a50e7b3f56f19c960e656abeba5.png
They may only use this power three times per voyage, so choosing when to check could provide pivotal strategic information. For example, you could check before and after an overboarding to see whether the number of ghosts goes down or up.

New Trait: The Influencer
The Influencer is a new passive trait for Trait and Trait+ games using the Crew's Choice event selection method. Customise a game to change the event selection method to Crew's Choice, and every day when an event occurs, each crew member can use the Compass of Fate to vote on which event they'd like to see happen. It's not majority rules, so even a single vote could be enough to doom the crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8489d3f9bb4fa6a07812fb02d56cb0dd0dbd8ddc.png
The Influencer has more power over the Compass of Fate, and every time they vote for an event, it will be three times more likely to be chosen. Will they use this influence for good, or for evil?

New Trait: The Vindicator
The Vindicator is a new passive trait for Trait and Trait+ games. Be wary of any voyage with The Vindicator, as they have quite a nasty power that's automatically activated any time they're voted overboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fb845902a58469c904008f1038888ad815297e6d.png
When The Vindicator is voted overboard, they'll place a curse on the pirates that voted for them. At the start of each subsequent voting round, The Vindicator will automatically place a number of votes on each pirate that doomed them - and these votes will continue to appear every day until a pirate is next voted overboard. Be careful when voting!

New Trait: The Resilient
The Resilient is a new passive trait for Trait and Trait+ games. The Resilient is harder to throw over than other pirates, and requires three votes above the current threshold as a minimum to be thrown overboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/57cf305a67ecd4a13794f0f30d666dde446bcc36.png
New Trait: The Fickle
The Fickle is a new active trait for Trait+ games. On days when The Fickle does not play in, they may activate their treat to privately and secretly exchange their current passive trait for another trait that no other pirate currently has.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/bfd03788080208b01bf73c6c303a14c55a9def59.png
They may only use this power three times per voyage, so they can't just change endlessly, but a pirate who's The Fickle could be The Tainted one minute and The Pure the next. Even worse, a pirate could just be pretending to be The Fickle - now that's a power play!

Updated Trait: The Gardener
The Gardener has gained access to a whole new plant! Spend three days growing some Deadly Nightshades to decorate the ship, and they'll make it so that events which mostly end with a pirate going overboard will be much more likely to occur. Very dangerous!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fb02eea52afd2f7033096d3230bbbb1d1bd7997d.png
New Event: Shifting Seasons
Shifting Seasons is a new event that appears in all game modes. When a Shifting Seasons event occurs, the crew will be able to vote on a seasonal change that will have a temporary significant impact on gameplay. The crew can choose whether they want to experience Longer Days or Longer Nights!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8e939cd151d134288238fa71a628678db9da092c.png
When the Longer Days effect is in play, there are two chances for events to occur each day. There's nothing stopping the same event from happening twice in a row, so you could even have a double Exorcism - or a double Possession! The events drawn in the bonus slot come from a selection of key events, so you won't end up with two Island Adventures in one day. Longer Days lasts for two days from when Shifting Seasons occurs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ee034ef62748b15369bc8557108ff85bdf2bdae4.png
When the Longer Nights effect is in play, all pirates will have a second chance to cast a vote during voting provided no pirate has gone overboard yet. Every vote counts when another pirate might use that vote to throw someone overboard! Longer Nights lasts for three voting rounds from when Shifting Seasons occurs.

New Event: Free For All
Free For All is a new event that appears only in Trait+ games. When a Free For All happens, an ongoing effect will trigger that allows all pirates to use their active traits without spending any resources. This means that active traits with charges will get one free use, The Witch can brew a potion without using any of their resources, The Reaper could enact a pact without spending souls, and many more possibilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2fdfb4b93bec5a6a255c2ed2d866859297254a2f.png
The effect only lasts for one day, so be careful who you choose to put in the job when Free For All is in effect. It also doesn't renew any of your resources, so if you've already used up all of your charges or spent all of your ingredients - you still won't be able to activate your ability. Maybe it's always worth saving a charge for the end of the voyage?

New Event: Swapportunity
Swapportunity is a new event that appears only in Trait+ games. When a Swapportunity happens, all pirates will have the option to choose whether they want to swap their passive trait with another pirate on the ship, or keep the passive trait they currently have.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e78452b9a6df327442179443b9ef196cf42f697f.png
If at least two pirates opt into the Swapportunity, then two pirates will be randomly selected to permanently exchange their passive traits. It's like The Traders, but for anyone, and only once!

New Event: Freakier Friday
Freaky Friday is a really popular event, and we've somehow made it even freakier! Freakier Friday is an event appearing in all game modes, which picks three pirates at random and shuffles their teams completely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7621bd3a08219e242676e98814e5281683d3508b.png
You'll know which three pirates were picked for the exchange, but you won't know whose team has gone to who, so there's lots of mystery to figure out!

New Trait Event: The Shapeshifter's Switch
The Shapeshifter's Switch is a new Trait event which can occur only when one of the crew is The Shapeshifter. When The Shapeshifter's Switch occurs, The Shapeshifter can choose any other pirate and flip their team. That means if they're a ghost they'll become human, and vice-versa. The pirate they pick is revealed to the whole team, so they have to be confident about their choice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/50b21ca185419af2aaf7c39f1f8a97c24047b1d0.png
Using The Shapeshifter's Switch will also use up one of The Shapeshifter's charges, meaning they can shift their shape one fewer time. Will they be willing to sacrifice a charge for greater good - or to cause mass chaos?

notes.title: The Traits+ Update
notes.notes:
New Game Mode: Traits+
We're super excited to launch our first new game mode since we introduced Traits way back in March 2021. Paper Pirates' new game mode, Traits+, is a whole new way to sail with traits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c2772102c57b38eaf766cb7587b611611ff143ff.png
When playing a Traits+ game, each crewmate will be given TWO traits - one active, and one passive. Active traits are traits that typically do something during the job phase when you either do, or don't, play in for a job. Think things like The Meddler, The Shapeshifter, and The Brawler. Passive traits are traits that are typically always in play. Think things like The Pure, The Tainted, and The Contrarian.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/32bdf69bee7a8340676d9967eb46df111b2c9c5e.png
We've updated the Captain's Log and the game customisation screen to clearly list which traits are active and which are passive. If your voyage configuration doesn't have enough active or passive traits to go round the whole crew, some of the pirates might be declared Innocent (in place of a passive trait), or Inactive (in place of an active trait).

Traits+ offers a whole new strategic layer to Paper Pirates, with over three hundred potential combinations. Will your traits work well with each other? Will they force you to side with the human team, or the ghost team? Will they pull you in two different directions? And how will you ever know who you can trust.

New Trait: The Traders
Our very first Traits+ exclusive Trait is The Traders, an active trait that always appears as a pair. The two pirates with The Traders can activate their shared ability any time either of them is not a job.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/aee7dc7ec05fe679e3af2f5d1a9ed4a86f85ef00.png
When activated, The Traders will exchange their passive traits with each other. When the traits swap, they carry all their charges, accumulated stats, and information with them. This opens up a raft of new strategic potential!

Be warned though... The Traders power only requires one of the two Traders to activate it, so if you're the second Trader, you might find yourself in an endless tug-of-war with your companion for a good passive trait!

New Trait: The Manipulator
The Manipulator is a new active trait appearing in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. The Manipulator's powerful ability allows them to target a pirate on days when they don't play in and force them to vote for a specific pirate the next time they vote.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e0cfdf2a05ac3d55e4b0709a0b0e3e61f79d5563.png
The Manipulator can use their power three times per voyage, and their power lasts until that player next votes, and also removes that pirate's option to pass their vote. The Manipulator could control of The Assassin to utilise them to nefarious means, take control of a mid-ship ghost engine, or force the Captain to vote for the Stowaway. The options are endless!

New Trait: The Retaliator
The Retaliator is a new passive trait appearing in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. The Retaliator's base voting power is always increased by the number of votes currently cast against them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fbc7934d4d34eff73f083e5683d6af31e7b4a0e1.png
The Retaliator's strength comes in taking revenge on those pirates that vote against them, but, it also has a raft of strategic potential. If you're willing to co-operate with other pirates, you could pool all your votes onto The Retaliator, concentrating the potential possession targets if you accidentally vote over a human...

But be careful, The Retaliator could always use all that accumulated voting power right back at you...

New Trait: The Torn
The Torn is a new passive trait appearing in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. When it's The Torn's turn to vote, they have the opportunity to vote twice! Each vote has half their base voting power (rounded up).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6fcd6a2ed3efa59cab02c6ee07b2f92c590b016e.png
The Torn can use each of their votes however they like. They can pass them both, use each one on a different pirate, the same pirate, or even use one and then pass the other. This allows them to be a little safer when throwing someone overboard, or to hedge their bets if they're just not sure.

New Event: Change of Trait
Change of Trait is a new event appearing only in Traits+ games. When a Change of Trait happens, a randomly chosen pirate will be offered the opportunity to change their passive trait. If they choose to accept, their passive trait will immediately change into a new passive trait that isn't already claimed by anyone else on the ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/648fa8fde47e309b67076e74af1316f885af61b3.png
The Change of Trait pirate doesn't get to see which passive trait they'll get in advance, so it's always risky. Watch out after a Change of Trait event - could a pirate have just become The Tainted?

Five New Achievements
With new content comes new achievements, and with new achievements comes new hats! There are five new tasks for you to complete to earn a lovely bounty of new hats for your crew to enjoy. The new achievements are:


 A Traitorous Sequel: Play a Traits+ Game
 Murderous Mind Games: As The Manipulator, force another pirate to throw you overboard
 The Retaliator's Revenge: As The Retaliator, throw a pirate who voted for you overboard
 Proficient Prognosis: As The Psychic, correctly predict which pirate will next go overboard in a The Psychic's Prediction event
 Top and Tail: As The Traders, trade traits while occupying the Captain and Stowaway ranks

Time Warp in Trait and Traits+ Games
With Traits+ offering the opportunity to be really playful with traits, we've updated the Time Warp event to now impact traits in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. This means that a Time Warp will now revert any trait progress, but also restores any charges spent in the aborted timeline. This means that The Witch recovers their used ingredients, The Legion might lose or gain ghosts, The Undecided might lose their current trait, and much more.

Make sure to check your Black Spot after a Time Warp to check who - or what - you even are...!

Trait Player Count Requirement Updates
We've reviewed the player count requirements for all traits, mostly bringing more advanced traits into smaller games. This will help games to feel fresh and exciting no matter how big your crews, and helps to balance the active and passive traits available to all crew sizes. We'll keep this under review, making changes where necessary.

notes.title: The Verdant Update
notes.notes:
New Traits and New Events!
In this Paper Pirates update, we've added two brand new never-seen-before traits to the permanent roster of traits. We've also added two new events and two new trait events!

New Trait: The Gardener
The Gardener is the first of our two new traits. The Gardener has access to three plant pots, and they can choose which plant to tend each day that they don't play in. There are four different plants that The Gardener might grow, so each voyage they'll only have a selection of a few!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2f9bb6f941c5a2d0a9c0d446f7648bdc7c9e198e.png
After a plant has been tended three times, it'll be fully grown, and will activate an ongoing effect that impacts the whole crew. From Saintly Sunflowers to Clingy Cacti, each plant is sure to turn the tide in the favour of one team or the either. Will The Gardener learn to work with their plants, or will they turn against them?

New Trait: The Undecided
The Undecided is the second of our new traits. The Undecided doesn't actually start with a trait! Each day, when The Undecided doesn't play in, they'll be offered a trait that's enabled for the voyage but which no other pirate currently has.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1f80438a023ce3506b7f9ff07cbd79ede7ea838d.png
Should they chose to accept this trait, The Undecided will then become that trait for the remainder of the voyage. Alternatively, they can pass on it, and hope that another trait comes along another day.

Whether The Undecided is taking advantage of becoming a trait that the crew needs just at the right time, or, finding out which traits are not currently on board the ship, they're sure to add some spice to your voyage!

New Trait Events
Building on the six trait events that were added in the last update, we've added another two - this time for The Psychic and The Cursed.

The Psychic's Prediction
In The Psychic's Prediction, The Psychic takes a guess at which pirate they think will next go overboard. If they ace their prediction, showing off their psychic abilities, they'll be rewarded with a choice of either moving the ship one space closer to shore or throwing a treasure overboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/94392131608f1f44daab5cf992f473dcf73eed98.png
The Cursed's Calamity
In The Cursed's Calamity, The Cursed will have an opportunity to potentially get thrown overboard. They'll be given a Magic Lamp-style event, but where the options are always Scurvy, Hot Potato, or Overpower. Which of these will give them the best chance of going overboard?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3fe86b139f65967c0c715369cc8e18345c672546.png
New Event: Reinvigoration
If the crew encounters a Reinvigoration event during a Trait game, any active trait that uses charges is sure to be celebrating - for they'll be gaining an extra charge for use during the remainder of the voyage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/15a84ef1706f9356e98aa37aacf337ab5e417cba.png
New Event: Confession
When a Confession event happens, one pirate from the crew is randomly chosen to share their deepest secret - which team they're on - with another pirate. They can't opt out so they have to pick someone they trust. Whoever they choose will get to find out whether the confessing pirate is a ghost or a human... but beware! In Trait games, Traits like The Disguised will still impact the outcome of the event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4b3eec1086d144b575507dbf6ad3805628ce854d.png

notes.title: The Trait Events Update
notes.notes:
Reworked Traits and New Events to spice up every voyage!
In this Paper Pirates update, we've reworked three traits to make them more desirable and give them more influence. There's also a whole host of new events for you to find to ensure that no two voyages are ever the same!

Reworked Trait: The Gifted
We love that The Gifted has a lot more control when they're the captain, and it's great how much control over the game being able to choose from three jobs gives you. However, not every Gifted finds their way to captaincy in every game, so we wanted to give The Gifted a little more to their toolkit to give them some oomph in games where they don't make it to the top of the ship.

The Gifted retains their ability to choose three jobs when they're the captain, but in addition, now has the ability to override the captain's job choice once per voyage with any job the crew are able to carry out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4b712e9b177d16f00a609f9558b1e757b75cfd65.png
Each day, The Gifted will see a large button on their device. If they press it, the captain's job choice will be interrupted, and they can choose any job which will happen that day. The captain still gets to choose whether they want to obey or disobey.

The Gifted can use their job choice strategically to make sure the job goes in their favour. Perhaps they want to definitely exclude, or even include, someone on the ghost team. Perhaps they want to work in partnership with an active trait to exclude them from a job - or stop them using their power by putting them in a job!

Reworked Trait: The Thief
When we made The Thief, we hoped it would be used as a vote deterrent so that ghosts had a way to try to avoid being voted overboard. The threat of losing a treasure versus the bonus of removing a ghost didn't have quite as much impact on games as we'd like, so we've reworked The Thief to make it more impactful.

When The Thief is chosen to play in for a job, they may choose to attempt a thievery. Once the job is resolved, the crew will be notified that there was an attempted thievery during the job. If The Thief is lucky, they'll steal a treasure from the crew and, as an added bonus, immediately turn into a ghost. If The Thief is unlucky, the crew will know an attempted thievery took place, but no treasure will be lost and The Thief will remain human.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9ff2d382009dd1cee49a9bdf6a5c3161640570f5.png
The Thief can only attempt a thievery while they're on the human team, so once you identify your thief, you might want to think carefully about how you deal with them!

Reworked Trait: The Medium
We love that The Medium adds a level of private information sharing to a voyage, but, with untargeted messaging it was sometimes difficult to use it effectively.

We've changed the way The Medium works, such that on days when they don't play in they may now choose any individual pirate to send a private message to. After the day's job has resolved, The Medium's message will be sent to their chosen pirate and most importantly, that pirate will then have the chance to send a secret message back to The Medium.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e974b0946d2d6964b8bb290554d95dada6e04072.png
This change empowers The Medium to become a master of secrets. Can they steal a secret from another pirate that gives them more power over the crew? Perhaps they want to share a secret about themselves with someone they trust?

New Event: Two of a Kind
The new Two of a Kind event is designed to help the crew out in a moment of need, giving them the opportunity to find out some more information. When a Two of a Kind event happens, a randomly chosen pirate is offered a choice of two pirates from the ship - including themselves but excluding the Stowaway.

The whole crew will see which two pirates were chosen, and then discover whether those two pirates are either both on the same team, or, on different teams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0884071a83252e5511e756ae720706642be51ae5.png
This is an opportunity to find out a little information about two teams, or, if you're on the ghost team, a chance to spread some real deception amongst the crew. Even if you know two people are on the same team, can you trust them...?

New Event: Trap of the Tainted
Trap of the Tainted is a brand new event that only appears in Trait games, and can only happen when someone on the crew is The Tainted.

In the initial phase of Trap of the Tainted, the pirate with the Tainted trait chooses any three pirates - including themselves - to lure into a dark and dangerous dungeon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b34d3dc9ca4e619f38c25e392b14e7976fdbd5d8.png
Once three pirates have been chosen, every other member of the crew, one by one, must choose which of them they'd like to leave behind in the dungeon. Being left behind in the dungeon is effectively the same as going overboard, so that pirate will return to the ship as a new stowaway and, if they were human, one of the pirates that voted for them will join the ghost team.

New Trait Events
We've added six brand new events which can only appear in Trait games which are themed around some of the existing traits, allowing a pirate with that trait the opportunity to influence the crew's voyage. Look out for any of the following events:


 The Berserker's Barrage
 The Legion's Liaison
 The Pure's Cure
 The Sensitive's Shuffle
 The Tainted's Touch
 The Twins' Tricks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4ff7c6d56a4b4ab6b1a60807c31d38ac2062e6d0.png
When one of these events shows up, you not only know that someone with that trait must be aboard the ship, you're also bound to experience some shenanigans sure to make you think twice about your fellow crewmates.

New Audience Event: Audience Influence
We've added a new audience event, Audience Influence! When an Audience Influence event happens, The Audience may collectively choose any pirate from the crew. The pirate who receives the most votes will become cursed, and will receive a small number of votes from the audience at the start of every voting round each day until a pirate is successfully voted overboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9c0c5f88688e227c75a2a886235a00bc6a637ad1.png

notes.title: History and Mystery Update
notes.notes:
Recap your voyage in more detail with the History and Mystery Update!
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the History and Mystery Update, featuring a refreshed game history feature, two new traits, a new event, and more!

New and Improved Game History
Our end-of-game recap screen, the Game History, was built for a simpler time when pirates didn't have things like traits. Although it's grown with us over time, it was starting to fall behind in providing a transparent recap of everything that happened in the game. So, we rebuilt it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e9e87240ffa84aa4453400a2854a011fb5af42e9.png
The new Game History includes more precise details, such as letting you know who voted for a Mutiny, as well as better handling of trait-influenced team changes and clearer indicators of when team changes happen.

Each day, you can review the job and who played in, see a summary of the events that took place, and check the outcome of voting. If you want to dig a little deeper, the details panel on the right will walk you through the day in detail.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8cbc6e47ed29d82a929b96b29e140b6599954315.png
You can also check who voted for who, who became a ghost, and what the probabilities were, in the Voting Chart!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d2c472098870247bd36d8e2624f0f13924575029.png
Last but not least, there's a bigger, bolder, and better final page in the Game History that more clearly indicates who on the crew were on the winning team. Open up the chart here and you can see exactly how your game played out over time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9bf2fe48eab24b5603da358efbe89d7c3d59067b.png
We love the new Game History and hope that it will help you better dissect your games. This was a huge project given the variety of voyages, and there might be the odd event or outcome that's missing text. We'll be keeping our eye out and patching these up as we go!

New Trait: The Silent
One of two new traits for the History and Mystery Update is The Silent!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4151876c78c61ac4fa1a59afaa78ebb86521a5e0.png
The Silent's votes are always secret. That means it will always appear as if they passed their vote, even if they didn't. Should The Silent cast enough votes to throw someone overboard, the voting will still end immediately. If you're The Silent and want to stay hidden, make sure you're casting votes where you won't be exposed.

And if you're not The Silent? Be wary. Joke votes sink boats! And with The Silent on board, you can never know exactly who might have been ghosted when a human goes overboard...

New Trait: The Gambler
Another new trait for the History and Mystery Update is The Gambler!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3a916a745bf499cd6107a667d289ef9fc51c5a69.png
On days when they don't play in, The Gambler is offered two events. One of these will have a high chance of happening, and one of them will have a low chance of happening. Whether The Gambler is a ghost or a human, the high-chance event will normally be good for their team, while the low-chance event will be bad for their team.

Are you willing to take a risk on a good event knowing what bad things might happen? Can you get away with risking it all and claiming that your events were the other way round?

Whether on the ghost team or the human team, The Gambler is sure to have you questioning whether you feel lucky!

New Event: Counting the Treasure
Our new event for the History and Mystery update is Counting the Treasure!

In a Counting the Treasure event, one pirate will be randomly selected to take on responsibility for counting the treasure. But never fear, they'll have help from three other pirates! Those three pirates will all see a number of coins on their device: Either 1, 2, or 3 coins. Their job is to tell the counting pirate how many coins they can see, so the counting pirate can add them up and report the total on their device.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b372fcde542f1bb1d67eaa8184cbf08e6559dec2.png
If you count correctly - amazing! The crew get another treasure! However, if you get it wrong, in the confusion it seems one of your current treasure will be whisked away before you can know it.

How much do you trust the three pirates chosen to help count the treasure? If it all goes wrong, who will you blame...?

Wishlist An Elaborate History of Chess on Steam now!
We've had a bit of a touch-up here and there, and we've replaced all of the older Iteration Games logos with our shiny new, all-blue logo! There's also a little reminder at the bottom of the title screen letting you know about our next game, An Elaborate History of Chess, coming soon on Steam. Wishlist now!

notes.title: All Together Update
notes.notes:
Set Sail with Random Players with the All Together Update!
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the All Together Update, featuring a new trait, public listing for games and more!

Public Games
When creating a Paper Pirates lobby, you now have the option of advertising your game publicly. Tick the "Public Games" tick box from the game customisation screen, and your lobby will be advertised for anyone to join via Spectator mode. Players joining public games will still have to join via a web browser on a connected device, but public games offer a way to recruit a crew even when playing solo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7a9b57de30d951e7d19fcef732a42509554dcccd.png

Remember, you can always mute or kick a pirate who joins your game and misbehaves to stop them contributing to the game any further. To do so, just click on a pirate in-game and choose the mute or kick option as appropriate. You can even do this from a lobby!

If you're looking to find more pirates to join your games, you're always welcome to join the Paper Pirates Discord server where you can advertise your games for anyone to join.

Mid-Game Spectating
To enhance the spectating experience, we've tightened up a few screws and enabled spectating mid-game. Whenever you join, you will have to wait for the start of the next day, but then your spectated game will be perfectly in sync with the host! You'll still get all the coins for the whole voyage, but note that your Round History will only display days for which you were already spectating.

New Trait: The Legion
Our new trait for the All Together Update is The Legion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1e567ce1aea41b9447ea650af77757847ef532ba.png

The Legion is a trait that is always assigned to a ghost at the start of a game, just like The Tainted. Whenever the Legion would become a ghost while a ghost, an extra ghost joins their collection. If they would become a human, one of the ghosts leaves their collection, but they remain a ghost. The only way to cleanse The Legion and return them to humanity is to clear their entire ghost collection!

The Legion always starts the game with one extra ghost in their collection, so at the very least you'll need to get them overboard twice, or give them two exorcisms, before they turn human. Never trust when you think someone is a human, because they could be The Legion!

New Trait: The Sleuth
As a reward for finding clues during Steam Mystery Fest, the collective efforts of pirates across the entire ocean unlocked a new Trait, The Sleuth! Although The Sleuth has been in the game for a few weeks now, we haven't formally introduced them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/56a4faaf968fe530924f0ef7b760797fd00704f1.png

The Sleuth has the power to investigate a pirate to see whether they have ever disobeyed at any point in the voyage so far. They won't know when they disobeyed, but this is still a very useful ability! In order to investigate a pirate, The Sleuth must use up a lead. Leads are earned every day that there are at least two disobeys in a job - so the more ghosts you have, the more likely your Sleuth is to find leads!

Additionally, The Sleuth always starts the game with one lead, so even if the ghosts are being on their best behaviour, they might not be able to hide from The Sleuth for long!

New Event: Disagreement
During a Disagreement event, two pirates from the centre of the ship have a falling out and decide to move away from each other. Each pirate will move as far away as they can, taking on the ranks of second-in-command and Cabin Boy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c2649852b64cfff54d418188c464dabb674bed24.png

New Event: Crew's Revenge
During a Crew's Revenge event, the entire crew will have the opportunity to take revenge on the most bloodthirsty pirate. If you've successfully thrown the most pirates overboard, you might find yourself facing a very angry crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f9a9b9eee46bde9290366f408b1400bb8d13944f.png

The Crew's Revenge event works like the Mutiny event, so if more than half of the crew vote to take revenge, the bloodthirstiest pirate will get thrown overboard. If they were a human, then any of the pirates that agreed to get revenge could become a ghost!

Join the Paper Pirates Community

notes.title: Berserker Update
notes.notes:
Channel your rage as The Berseker!
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the Berserker Update, featuring a new trait and some QoL improvements throughout!

New Trait: The Berserker
Our new trait for the Berserker Update is The Berserker!

The Berserker is the master of channelling their rage, but sometimes they just just have to let it all out! Each time The Berserker passes their vote, they will gain an additional one voting power. This keeps increasing each time they pass their vote! When they unleash their rage, their bonus voting power reduces to zero, and it can be built up again.

But beware, lest you be overcome by your rage! If The Berserker's normal voting power plus their bonus voting power is greater than or equal to the vote threshold, they will lose their ability to pass their vote. This means they must throw someone overboard - no questions asked!

Make sure that you manage your rage carefully, lest you accidentally end up throwing a human overboard all on your own and becoming a ghost...

More Animated Votes
We've given the black spots used during a voting a little bit more energy! They've now got a nice animation that makes it clearer how many votes a pirate is casting, and also includes a better visual display of how many votes each pirate cast should a pirate go overboard.

It now feels much more exciting to vote for someone, but be careful who you vote for because you might be making more ghosts on the ship!

Outfit Shop Quality of Life Improvements
Sam Sherbot is always hard at work to help make shopping at the Outfit Shop a dream. They've introduced two new features to help you browse, try on and shop with maximum comfort!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d1e7db69ab37aa1cb5b68d6afc81e7acd13e7268.png

Buy Whole Sets
Complimenting the Buy Whole Outfit button added in 3.5, Sam now advertises whole sets for sale. This might be all the parts to dress up as your favourite animal, or many other costumes where different outfit parts just all work together! Pick a whole outfit, and buy all the pieces in one go using the Buy Whole Outfit button. Spending your hard earn coins has never been so easy!

Try on Hats
Sometimes, to complete the perfect outfit, you need the perfect hat. Sam's giving you the opportunity to browse your hat collection, and you can now try on hats in the Outfit Shop! You have to have unlocked a hat for it to appear in the list, but once you do, you can try it on with all the other outfit parts. It'll also be added to your outfit code, so you can dress a pirate up completely without ever even opening the lobby!

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our Discord!

notes.title: Protection and Peril Update
notes.notes:
It's Perilous on the High Seas!
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the Protection and Peril Update, full of new features to spice up your voyages!

New Trait: The Reaper
Our first new trait for the Protection and Peril Update is The Reaper!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/df0ab8f90c3a803cf2e84d2afe884eda3f5fa01e.png

Whenever any other pirate goes overboard, The Reaper harvests a soul, collecting them for nefarious deeds. When The Reaper does not play in, they can spend the souls they've harvested to form one of several pacts, influencing the game in a powerful way.

Each voyage, the four pacts The Reaper can enact are chosen randomly, so it's never quite the same twice in a row! Will you use the power of The Reaper for good, or for evil?

New Trait: The Protector
Our second new trait for the Protection and Peril Update is The Protector!

During Day One, The Protector must choose any other pirate to protect. No matter how many votes the protected pirate receives during voting, they will not be thrown overboard. The pirate they choose to protect is a secret until the point at which they would have gone overboard, when the pirate will display a shield and become immune to further votes that round!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/635a632f8936b47acffd6bd35492d0c027e03e7d.png

On days when they don't play in, The Protector may choose to change which pirate they're protecting. Who will The Protector choose to protect, and will they make sure they change their mind in time?

Empowering the Audience!
Alongside the new traits, we're giving the audience more power! We've added over ten new events, which will only appear when you have an audience watching your game. Each event allows the audience to influence the game in some important way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f41ac68771e50c854b641145eb1926122885257e.png

When the audience is empowered, they can do things like choose a new captain, turn someone into a ghost, swap two pirate's teams, and much more. Who's watching your game? Do you trust them to help the humans, or are they sneaky ghosties?

You can customise how often an empowered audience event happens in your games, including turning them off completely, in the custom game menu under the Events tab.

Two New Events: Disarray & Equality
We're welcoming two new regular events to Paper Pirates - Disarray and Equality. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4a7f96a5e00a3b6c436a13489590864c5b496797.png

When the Disarray event happens, the crew become disoriented and confused, and an ongoing effect triggers which shuffles the order of voting randomly each day! This can really mess with the natural order of voting, so watch carefully who votes first!

When the Equality event happens, the crew commit to equality for all pirates. In terms of voting, this means that all pirates will have the same number of votes! This empowers the stowaway, and weakens the Captain, and can easily change up who votes for who.

Both Disarray and Equality last from when the event triggers until the next time a pirate is voted overboard.

Shop Enhancements
Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have invested in some upgrades for their shops, and added some new features and functionality!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a6594e710da44f6b075f61c2a29cda16a8b7299b.png

The Outfit Shop has been upgraded with the following new features:

 Categories with newly added items now have a 'new' label, and individual items in categories will also tell you that they've recently been added to the shop.
 More accurately customise the model in the shop, including options to try on different left and right hands and feet.
 Create outfits in the Outfit Shop, and copy the Outfit Code directly from the shop ready for use in the in-game lobby! This also means you can create Outfit Codes using items you haven't bought yourself yet.
 Once you've finished dressing up the pirate model in the Outfit Shop, there's a new option to buy all the items you don't own in one go. Customise a whole look, and buy it in one fell swoop for the ultimate convenient shopping experience!

The Ship Shop has been upgraded, and Nat O'Bother will now offer regular sales on their ship parts. The items on sale change once every week, so if you see something on sale that you can't quite afford, there's still time to save up and buy, buy, buy!

More Customisation Options!
Sam Sherbot has been sailing far and wide to bring you the latest pirate fashions! Become a wolf or an elephant, turn your pirate into an orc, and more with a new range of outfit shop items available for purchase!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a1b380245e7350ce89eee07176df4aac872be9c4.png

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our Discord!

notes.title: 3.3.3 Patch
notes.notes:
The Witch - promoted to a permanent Trait!
We've had an outpouring of love for our Haunted Seas seasonal trait, The Witch, from all areas of the Paper Pirates community. So much so that we've made the decision to make The Witch a permanent trait, available all year round!

New content for Día de Muertos
We've made some additions to our Day of the Dead seasonal celebration, full details can be found in the Día de Muertos seasonal celebration event page.

Bug Fixes

 A message questioning how all the treasure went overboard when there are no ghosts on board was accidentally displayed twice as part of the game end sequence.
 In rare circumstances, when The Wishful was played by a bot, it could cause the active trait timer to wait out its full duration when a decision was already made.
 All pirate templates with any of the Parrot hats would default back to the Scarlet colouration when re-entering a lobby. Your correct choice of Parrot should now be recorded!

3.4 update arriving soon!
