notes.title: Meddlesome Update
notes.notes:
New Trait: The Meddler
Our first new trait for The Meddlesome Update is The Meddler!

On days when The Meddler does not play in, they may choose a pirate that is playing in and change whatever they’ve chosen to play in today to either an obey or a disobey. Like other active traits, their power is limited and The Meddler can only meddle a maximum of three times each voyage.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9306175911869a17416e809e272599e15b1b5609.png

When a meddle takes place, the pirate whose job was meddled will receive a private prompt on their device to let them know that they’ve been meddled (and whether their choice is being forced to obey or disobey), and just before the job cards are revealed on the main screen you will see an indication that a meddle took place today.

Whether your Meddler is a ghost trying to meticulously frame a human pirate, or a human pirate thwarting the plans of your ghosts, The Meddler is sure to add an extra layer to all your social deducting.

New Trait: The Sensitive
Our second new trait for The Meddlesome Update is The Sensitive!

The Sensitive is able to tell, by checking their black spot, whether they are currently next to a ghost on the ship. That means if the pirate one rank up, or down, from them is a ghost - or even if both are! - The Sensitive will know that they’re near some spooky business.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/695b810021d2b3e88c2dae25248f1ce1e91a1836.png

The Sensitive adds a whole new perspective to events which change pirate’s rank and positions on the ship. Watch out when the captain promotes you - they might be bringing you into the suspicion of The Sensitive!

New Feature: The Ship Shop
Nat O’Bother has opened up his Ship Shop - a new expansion to the Shop Ship! Bobbing in his barrel, but always ready to go, nothing is too much bother for our Nat!

The Ship Shop’s specialism is helping you to customise your ship - as displayed on the title screen and sailing while you’re on a voyage. Everyone gets a free ship slot by default, so you can visit Nat and start building right away!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8bd93184be18d30dfbdef36c3a9fdc55b202f180.png

Nat sells a wide range of ship parts for PP Coins, from figureheads to flags, from sails to sterns, and you can combine them to build the ship of your dreams. To top things off, he’s also here to help you give each ship a name and icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0727589791b30ddb1bb6c08f64888d90016c5d5f.png

If you’re feeling flush and customisation’s your thing, Nat can also sell you additional ship slots which let you own more than one ship - saving custom ship configurations to switch between quickly. The more ships you own, the more they cost, so having a navy of seaworthy ships might take more adventurin’ than you expect!

New Event: Ominous Winds
With The Meddlesome Update, we’re also introducing one new event - Ominous Winds! When Ominous Winds blow, a pirate is sure to see an omen of the future. What will this omen do? Will it threaten to throw a pirate overboard? Offer them a promotion to captain? Or something else entirely?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4408e502c08a72121691ccdd216d2235ac3694d3.png

All omens are tracked as ongoing events (so you can see the details at the side of the screen!) and grant a sense of impending fortune or doom to a particular pirate. Will your omen play out, or will it expire before it has a chance to take effect?

UI Improvements
We’ve made some improvements to the Paper Pirates UI to increase readability, and to help add understanding to the way the game is played. The following three key features are designed with new players in mind in particular:

The Phase Tracker
In the top left of the game screen, you’ll now see the phase tracker. The phase tracker indicates which stage (playing in, event or voting) of the current day you’re at, and which one is coming up next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a3091ff46357f8dc9769c58ba52bf924978134f7.png

Device Action Reminders
We’ve made it more clear when someone needs to take an action on their device, with a clearer indicator above a pirate. These trigger when a pirate needs to make a choice in an event or vote a pirate overboard for example.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3296d0f251f1cbbaea3c7203b733542c5c98dd17.png

‘Who Voted?’ Indicators
In addition to the existing ‘Who voted for who’ tracker on each player’s device, we’ve added a visual indicator of who cast votes for who during voting in the form of coloured black spots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ecb3195dcc89c05181376cc9da6a406dcb15b70f.png

‘Can Create a Ghost’ Indicator
When an event has an action or decision that might create a ghost, the event message box will give you a little warning to let you know. Look out for this as a helpful reminder when weighing up whether it’s worthwhile to poison that soup or not!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/947f287a58fcb53774bc425986f7e70c3e5e043a.png

We’ve also given the Credits page a bit of a facelift - check it out to see the pirates on the Iteration Games crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/536bad5f6c7124a14c5b62596633f7098aa88b50.png

notes.title: Deduction and Deception Update
notes.notes:
New Trait: The Shapeshifter!
It’s great to see so many people having fun with Trait games, and the popularity of The Wishful hasn’t gone unnoticed. We’re super excited to introduce some additional new traits in 3.2, which share The Wishful’s playful sense of having a power they can activate on days when they don’t play in.  Our first new trait in 3.2 is: The Shapeshifter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/10bf6a9bae5f2bbe32b36043d4b768e98b59d063.png

On days when The Shapeshifter does not play in, they may shift their shape, swapping their team (from human team to ghost team, or from ghost team to human team).  Like The Wishful, their power is limited and The Shapeshifter can only change their shape three times each voyage.  

The big limiting factor on The Shapeshifter is only being able to use their power when they don’t play in. Will you take the opportunity to shift your team early in the game, hoping things play out as you expect, or risk a later game switch and risk playing in every day and ending up trapped on the losing team?

New Trait: The Interrogator!
Our second new trait in 3.2 is: The Interrogator!

On days when The Interrogator does not play in, they may prepare an interrogation by choosing a pirate and a specific trait.  They will then be told whether their interrogation was correct or incorrect through their trait information in the black spot.  Like The Wishful and The Shapeshifter, their power is limited and The Interrogator can only prepare three interrogations each voyage.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/cdd1beb2297f38f760d9424d66b22598a7ef0635.png

As with most traits, The Interrogator can begin the game on either the Human team or the Ghost team, so you never know whether your Interrogator is working for good or for evil. Even if they’ve managed to uncover some juicy information, can you always trust what they want to share with the crew?

Reworked Trait: The Disguised!
We love The Disguised, and we know that you do too, but one of the things we’ve heard from a lot of players is that they want it to have more interaction throughout the game than with just The Psychic.  The Disguised rework makes their trait apply to all team reveals through traits or events. Spy on a pirate who’s Disguised? Their team will be flipped! Census with a pirate who’s Disguised? It will report one higher, or lower, than the actual number of ghosts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9032228c5b227cb68d3c11f828d66ad61a76523e.png

The Disguised now adds a lot of uncertainty to your games, and it’s a very safe claim for any initial ghost players - but as with all traits, it can only appear once, so watch out for those counter-claims (and maybe use the power of your Interrogator, if you have one, to find the real one).

As part of the rework, we’ve also made it so The Disguised can appear independently of The Psychic - so for those of you whose strategies relied on the presence of The Disguised to confirm or de-confirm the presence of The Psychic, you might need to think of new ways to force your Psychic out of hiding!

‘Watch a Pirate’ - On-screen team reveal
Following the introduction of Spectator Mode in the Traitorous Update, we’ve added a new feature for players who would like to make their pirate’s team (and secret objective in Scored Games, or trait in Trait Games) public. We’ve seen streamers using Spectator Mode to run fantastic multi-perspective streams, and by using Watch a Pirate they can choose to share their team publicly on their stream with their viewers, while keeping it secret from other spectators.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e14ca42ef7d64c5cf26d7ea5d43197ccc119a382.png

To initiate the ‘Watch a Pirate’ feature, you can click on any pirate in the lobby or in-game and choose ‘Watch Pirate’ from the pop-up menu. This player will then receive a prompt on their device to approve or deny the request. At any time, you can stop watching a pirate using the close button next to the pirate’s information.

New Player Tutorial
For players new to Paper Pirates, we’ve added a Tutorial Island to the Plot a Course options. The Tutorial offers a more guided, gentler introduction to Paper Pirates, with some in-depth explanations of the various mechanics as you play through the game. The Captain will appear on-screen, with animations, to explain to you what the rules are regarding playing in, voting, events, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8757b53a6b79eb5aeb8de8618e40a540c19cb36d.png

Additionally, if you are new to Paper Pirates, The Captain will introduce you to all the key features of the game, including The Captain’s Log and The Bounty Board. If you’re a Paper Pirates veteran, The Captain might pop up from time to time to tell you about a feature you already know about - but rest assured, he’s only trying to be helpful!

New ‘Choose a Pirate’ Screens
Whenever you have to choose a pirate - either in voting or in an event - we’ve added a little bit of extra personality to the screen by including little avatars of each player’s pirate, plus their pirate colour in big chunky (harder to misclick!) buttons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/452d7e612e24d5a9f11e58dd00ccfb0dab1d428b.png

Improved In-Game Update Notes
The Update Notes button from the title screen has had a facelift! The in-game update notes now cover the headline features of each update, with a short description, right in the client. It’s a little more fun and friendly than the notes that were there before! The full patch notes are always available on Steam for anyone who wants to dive into the full details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4f3954ba30ec960c178eabf8f3ff8c3eea0f910c.png


A Few Other Things
 We’ve made some general improvements to the Photo Booth, which now saves your snaps with correct transparency. That means if you want to take a pic of your pirate against the green screen background, you now get a nice crisp copy of your pirate on their own ready for you to use as you wish!
 If you have Remote Start enabled in the options, the pirate who has the option to start the game is now labelled in the lobby with the addition of a crown icon.
 We’ve added Steam Rich Presence, which shows what’s going on in your Steam Friends List while you’re playing Paper Pirates!
 A few additional tracks of music have been added to the game so listen out when planning a voyage or journeying to the Shop Ship!


Bug Fixes

 We lost our special Paper Pirates cursor icon temporarily, but it has now returned!

notes.title: Wishful Update
notes.notes:
New Trait: The Wishful!
After adding the Trait game mode in 3.0, we’ve had an outpouring of positive feedback, and it’s clear that everyone loves playing Paper Pirates with Traits! One of the most common requests we get is for more traits, so with 3.1 we’re introducing the first new Trait: The Wishful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5992f94069dc3996f1a02d916564bacf17635982.png

On days when The Wishful does not play in, they may wish for an event from a selection displayed on their device. Their power is limited, however, and The Wishful only has three wishes - so can only use their power three times during any voyage.  Whether they use their power for good to help the humans, or for evil to help the ghosts, The Wishful is sure to have a huge impact on any games where they appear!

New Event: Stowaway’s Brawl
We’re retiring an older event that we don’t think fits the Paper Pirates ethos, so we’re saying goodbye to Shipwreck in normal gameplay (it’ll still appear in certain Daily Voyages though, so it’s not gone for good!). To replace Shipwreck, we’re introducing a new event: Stowaway’s Brawl!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/734e0ec98ff2c894f6d674d11b02351feca49ebd.png

During a Stowaway’s Brawl, a random pirate is chosen to brawl with the stowaway. The two brawling pirates each choose from rock, paper or scissors; Rock beats scissors, paper beats rock, and scissors beats paper. If the defending pirate wins or there’s a draw, nothing happens, however, if the stowaway wins, the stowaway and the defending pirate swap ranks!

The Shop Ship: Gene Botley’s Map Shop
Sam Sherbot has set sail and set up shop with Gene Botley! The pair are now the proud owners of the brand new Shop Ship, which houses Sam Sherbot’s Outfit Shop as before, and the all-new Map Shop run by Gene Botley.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/30adb36d92c028e50a1b159385c28a5896eb29e3.png

The Map Shop offers pirates an opportunity to buy maps for a small amount of PP Coins which show you how to reach a previously played Daily Voyage. The Daily Voyage locations are mysterious though, so each map can only be used once! Be sure to visit Gene’s Map Shop if there’s any Daily Voyages you particularly enjoy playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/da1e43e16913a07dea14aec232d393e6649751fa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f42bcbe25adb0bf2f393f5ac3ab11fbc4642fbee.png

Nine New Daily Voyages
To celebrate the opening of Gene Botley’s Map Shop, we’ve expanded the destinations you can visit on your daily voyages with nine brand new daily voyages! They’re entering the daily voyage rotation, so look out for them appearing when you check your daily voyage each day. Including new adventures where the crew can get stranded on a desert island, to being thrown overboard by a lethal assassin, there’s a whole new suite of configurations here offering a new take on Paper Pirates every day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87f6eff882ce12bcb9beb88918995f278616c871.png

Save your Custom Game Configurations
We love making custom games, and we know that you do too! To help streamline the process, we’ve added the functionality for you to save a predefined configuration to play again later. You can save up to fifty different game setups, and access these directly from the new Plot a Course menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/defcfba93d71865c5c23a1c39c4fa53215822ec8.png

Plot a Course Menu
To help keep things fresh, we have a new menu screen for when you’re choosing to plot a course. Deciding between a Classic, Scored or Trait game has never been more fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/95a6c1814a8fd4b5f2767f756bb59d65b94501ff.png

Additionally, the Plot a Course screen lets you access your saved Custom Configurations or play any Maps you’ve bought from Gene Botley’s Map Shop!

Revamped ‘How to Play’ Guides
We’ve overhauled the way the how to play information is presented from the game setup screens, to make it more informative and to help new players get into the game. Filled with video clips and guides to show the different elements of Paper Pirates, we hope the How to Play button for each game mode offers a quick and easy way to bring any new players up to speed on how to get started with Paper Pirates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87c3d1346e6dd83e1a17a24360e8e48271170487.png

Additionally, we’ve made some improvements to the ‘How to Play’ button on the device. If you’ve got players who are new to the game, make sure to point them to the menu - there’s always a handy rule summary there if they need it!

In-game Chat Tooltips
When you’re playing Paper Pirates on your device, we’ve given a few bits and pieces a lick of paint to make them look a bit spiffier. As part of the visual overhaul, we’ve also added tooltips to the in-game chat! Say the name of a secret objective in a Scored Game, or a Trait in a Trait Game, and it’ll create a tooltip link where you can immediately check out the details of that objective or trait, directly from the chat interface. Handy for all landlubbers new to the crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6fd869a6575162e013c08d31bb25b595fb5d5aa6.png

New Emotes
The new in-game chat interface also comes with an added bonus: four new emotes! Your pirates have never been so expressive! The four new emotes include waving, laughing, confusion and most excitingly, a rank-based emote! That’s right, whether you’re the Captain, Stowaway, Cook, or any other rank, pressing the rank-specific emote button will have your pirate enact a little animation that’s unique to that rank! They’re super cute!

A Few Other Things

 The ‘Default’ game mode is now referred to as the ‘Classic’ game mode throughout Paper Pirates
 We’ve made some improvements to the Day One experience for spectators, to decrease the likelihood of spectators having to wait until the host reaches day two to start spectating
 There’s a new “Copy” button in the Lobby, next to where the room code appears. Clicking the copy button copies a join URL to your clipboard, which you paste into any chat applications to share with your crew. If they click the link, they’ll be taken to the Paper Pirates joining website, with the room code already pre-filled (e.g. https://paperpirat.es/?room=TEST) to make joining your game even easier! What’s even better - you don’t need to reveal the room code to copy the URL to your clipboard, so if you’re streaming the game, you can share the link to join the game without even needing a room code hider!
 If you’ve got ‘Auto-hide Room Code’ turned on in your game options, entering a room code to spectate a game will now hide the room code as you enter it so you don’t reveal the room code to your audience when streaming


Bug Fixes

 The default number of innocent players in a customised trait game should now be a more rational number
 Bots sometimes failed to hide from the wasps in the Wasp Nest event, but should now always be ready to jump into a barrel!

notes.title: 3.0.2 Patch
notes.notes:
After the launch of update 3.0, the Traitorous Update, we're just pushing some bug fixes that we missed or introduced during the development of 3.0.


 In Trait games, The Diligent was ending games way too quickly when they were the captain, this was unintended. The Diligent now does not double outcomes when they are the captain, more accurately matching the in-game description.

 The Auto-Hide Roomcode option was broken by the addition of Spectate mode and would not hide the room code automatically when enabled, this has now been fixed.
 
 3.0.1 also went live a few days ago with some immediate bug fixes, Mac and Linux builds received this update but instead still displayed version number 3.0.0, this has now been fixed in the upgrade to 3.0.2!

notes.title: Traitorous Update
notes.notes:
New Game Mode: Trait Games!
Our third game mode adds another new way to sail on the seven seas! Returning to the original team-based nature of Paper Pirates, the Trait game mode gives you a whole new way to help your team - whether you’re a human, or a ghost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/cbd287ed5dcfbac4bc3c53b7a6cd23513a949836.png

Traits
At the start of a Trait game, pirates are allocated a unique trait from the eleven traits available. These traits give each pirate a twist on the way they play the game - for example, The Assassin will always vote first in each round of voting, while The Pure cannot ever become a ghost, no matter who they vote for or what actions they take in events. Whether you choose to share your trait with the crew, keep it a secret, or maybe play more sneakily and weave a fishy tale to cover your tracks by lying about your trait, they’re sure to totally change the way that you play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b29ffff484c11e6443b98314a0e600866b5c0b11.png

You can learn about all of the Traits in the Captain’s Log, and when making a Trait in Custom Games you can also choose to include or exclude specific traits based on your own personal preferences!

Innocents
In each game, a number of pirates may be allocated the Innocent Trait. These pirates have no special abilities, but are excellent scapegoats for mischief. If you’re not ready to disclose your Trait yet, or simply want to cause some trouble, you can always claim to be Innocent! In Custom Games, you can use the slider to set a minimum and maximum number of Innocent pirates, to personalise the game to your liking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/16111f8b43217740e3508bf207809b4b4dced256.png

Game Spectating
We know that many of you play Paper Pirates remotely, with people who aren’t - or can’t - be with you in person. To help you play together, we’re introducing a spectator game mode. To spectate a game, enter the game’s room code after launching the spectator mode from the main menu while they’re still in the lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87d317039a1833f64a6cbc4ba34d08d4980b9cec.png

To join the game as a pirate, you’ll still need to use the Paper Pirates website (https://paperpirat.es), but now the main screen will be replicated to anyone spectating through their own copy of the Steam game.

We hope that this enables more people to play Paper Pirates together where screen sharing facilities might otherwise be unavailable. Now, to play together, all you need is a copy of the game each and a room code!

Community Bounties
Bounties have levelled up! With 3.0, we’re introducing Community Bounties to Paper Pirates. When a community bounty is active, you’ll see it right at the top of the title screen. These bounties have big goals, and must be completed within a limited time - but the good news is, anyone who plays Paper Pirates during the bounty contributes to the Community Bounty! If everyone completes the bounty before the time’s up, a limited-time reward - such as increased gold rewards - will become available to everyone playing games for the duration of the reward!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d7475a8691de48f6bb705ab66c6003f6e5fcf5c6.png

The first bounty starts RIGHT NOW, challenging everyone to complete 100 games within seven days. Reaching the goal will unlock a 1.5x coin multiplier to all coins earned for seven days after the bounty’s completion!

Please note that to participate in a Community Bounty, you must have the ‘Collect Anonymous Usage Data’ feature turned on in the Options menu, so that we know you’ve played a game!

And what do the people at home think?
We’ve also added a new way to choose your events when playing in Custom Games! We’ve heard that pirates love when the audience participates, and some of you were always disappointed when each new day passed and the audience’s choice didn’t happen. So the new mode - Audience Choice - ensures that, when an event needs to happen, if you have an audience and they’ve picked events, it’ll always choose one of their choices!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c8b97fda9d94130fe4615c8b323040f8f1b356c2.png

If you select Audience Choice and you don’t have an audience, or they’re feeling a little sheepish about making choices, you’ll get random events as normal. Nothing ventured, nothing gained, as they say!

A Few Other Things

 New regular bounties are available, asking you to play a number of Trait games, or games with the event selection method set to Audience Choice
 Three new achievements - and hats! - relating to Trait Games have been added for you to earn
 Trait Games statistics have been added to the Leaderboard


Bug Fixes

 Occasionally in Crossing the Gap, the person who fell from the vines could be haunted by their own ghost! Oops! That should no longer be possible, because who’d haunt themselves?!
 Coloured hats worn by pirates on the docks in Fishing for Treasure sometimes mysteriously looked as if they’d taken on brand new appearances, and didn’t match their true appearance. This should no longer be the case!
 The achievements ‘Treading Water’ and ‘Greedy for Gold’ were sometimes not correctly granted to players who had moved further from shore, or earned treasure, during their voyage.

notes.title: Adventures Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=p-IpcZaeZ4I;full][/previewyoutube]

Adventure Events
Patch 2.8 brings with it a grand sense of adventure, as we introduce a new type of event to Paper Pirates! When an Adventure Event occurs during your journey, the crew temporarily takes a pitstop, engaging in a mini-adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/be35f1fe704f7521601e78eb2914935a3a1ccf4a.png

During an adventure, the crew have the chance to pick and choose which events take place, and multiple events will happen in quick succession. It’s an all new way to experience events - and the things that happen on an adventure don’t just stay on the adventure, they’re going to affect your game when you’re back on the ship too!

The Island Adventure
The very first Adventure Event is the Island Adventure, where the crew explore an island they discover way out in the seven seas! Together you have enough resources to explore two regions of the island, so pick wisely which bits of the island you want to see each time you visit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ef67d95bfeb1064f2777d12811e43558ddb111f2.png

The island has nine regions in total, which means there are nine new fun-filled events for you to experience as part of the Island Adventure. From fishing off the docks to diving for treasure, whichever activities you try out on your trip to the island it’s sure to shake things up in your game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e807bffa018d9e1ad242a6fbc1fa605eda6e6659.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/22c8ffbdfd7bafd432a746c90c3bdfe39286b298.png

As an extra bonus, there are five new achievements relating to the island. Work hard when you’re on an adventure, and maybe you will discover a new hat for your efforts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c561ed0828e57b5a7cf3095981a69b6e91fb2a88.png

Dress for Adventure in the Outfit Shop
Our resident shopkeeper, Sam Sherbot, is already well acquainted with the island, and has stocked up the Outfit Shop with a whole new range of island-themed goodies for you to browse and purchase using the coins earned for playing Paper Pirates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8539c269b39aed1263bab3393d5633b730e4be17.png

Continuing on the theme of dress-up, why not make an explorer outfit for your pirates - or go undercover and try to mingle with the local wildlife!

In total, there are over forty new outfit shop items, so there’s plenty of new ways for you to customise your pirates.

New Outfit Customiser
As the number of things Sam Sherbot has on sale grows, we’ve overhauled the outfit customiser to make it more manageable when you have a large wardrobe for your pirates! The new outfit customiser is visible immediately when connecting to a game, and lets you start customising your pirate’s look right away. Don’t worry - the randomise buttons are still there for those of you who love to leave your look all up to chance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/503c440b121bb28b9f7a4879ad43f605bab88ee9.png

Additionally, a new option on the outfit customiser lets you save your current outfit to a code, which you can then store and paste into the outfit customiser again to recreate your current look with one simple button press! This gives all pirates a great way to share dress-up tips, store a full range of outfits, or bring your outfit from one person’s game to another. If the owner of the game doesn’t have all the items in your outfit unlocked yet, they’ll get swapped out randomly for something they do have, so you might even uncover some new variations on your outfit that you love!

Daily Sales at the Outfit Shop
Sam Sherbot has been feeling generous of late, so they’re going to start offering a daily sale in the outfit shop. Each day a few categories from the shop will have a select number of items on sale, sometimes for as much as 75% off! The sales are the same for everyone, so if you see an item that’s a total steal, don’t forget to let your friends know so they can visit the Outfit Shop and pick it up for their game too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5796c5bdc0342950e0ed0cfd57edbf0a1f39f860.png

A Few Other Things

 We’ve revisited the Mutiny event to include crew interaction ensuring that the mutiny never feels like a product of bad luck. In the revamped Mutiny event, all players are given an opportunity to vote in secret as to whether they favour the mutiny, or not. If half or more of the crew vote to Mutiny, the captain is thrown overboard, with anyone who voted for the Mutiny having a chance to become a ghost if the captain was a human.
 We’ve improved the way events are chosen each day, so you should see events that you see less often appearing more, to help keep every game fresh and unique!
 The timer now has a visual indicator, which shows the number of seconds remaining before time’s up!
 The ‘Bandana’ outfit category has been renamed to ‘Headwear’ to more accurately reflect the type of items in this category.
 Attempting to start the game from a connected device now triggers a short countdown before the game is started. Attempts to start the game can be aborted from the main screen before the timer elapses.


Bug Fixes

 A rare bug which caused pirates to play-in twice is now hopefully resolved.
 Some text in the How to Play Guide for Default Games was accidentally duplicated, and has now been removed.

notes.title: Ongoing Update
notes.notes:
Events That Go On and On
We’re adding a new class of events to Paper Pirates, and reclassifying some of the old events to add clarity and readability to the game! ‘Ongoing Events’ are events which trigger some subtle rule or state change to the game, which lasts until something happens. You can see which ongoing events are currently in play by hovering over the ongoing event tabs in the top left of the main screen, or checking the ‘Ongoing Events’ pop-up from the menu on your device.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/97902111f3fc2d342a3a585f65863415085912d6.png

Six Brand New Events
With ongoing events, we’ve not only reclassified some existing events, but we’re introducing six brand new events too! This brings the number of events in Paper Pirates - not including events only available through seasonal celebrations - up to forty-two!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/acb94b0133a85682c33bae55e8c19a193e21cd76.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/11c3c32cd513ce7917831e2c1cef0f6d0e1258d9.png

Five of these are new ongoing events, and one of them is a regular event, but they’re all aimed at switching up the way you play! From Seeing Red, which prevents pirates from skipping their vote until someone is voted overboard, to Captain’s Fortune, which gives the captain three job choices at the start of each day instead of two until a job is successful, we’re sure these new events will mix up your games and add new strategies!

Ten New Achievements
With new events, once again comes a bumper crop of new achievements - and as always, each new achievement comes with a new hat, which you can unlock as soon as you earn the achievement. If you want to be the most fashionable pirate on the seven seas, track down any of the ten new achievements as quickly as you can, and try out the new hats before the rest of yer crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/97c7b25881a2c4ecbec6a3fd914dd7ba9cf85d9a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/20aef87ebd1801fa6702b9169cb32de1d74496ca.png

Play Dress-up in Paper Pirates!
Sam Sherbot has been visiting many far off regions collecting the very best top pirate fashions from all over the world for sale in the Outfit Shop, all ready for you to play dress-up! They’ve brought back over 40 new items for you to spend your hard-earned pieces of eight on, many of which make perfectly coordinated outfit sets! Make sure that after playing a game or completing a bounty you check out the Outfit Shop to see what new things you can buy! If you’ve got one piece of a set, don’t forget to play more games so that you can get the other pieces - it would be a crime to miss out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ba488e757a1f434d646f0dbc96a5e99847baab8a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/90dc4117069bd4a1378b53d469bd5c22c88af46a.png

Don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our Discord!

notes.title: Bounties Update
notes.notes:
Complete Bounties to Earn Coins!
Bounties add a whole new way for you to earn coins for the Outfit Shop while playing Paper Pirates! Check the Bounty Board from the title screen, and you’ll see the bounties you currently have active. Complete bounties - such as Play 3 Scored Games - during your Paper Pirates adventures, and next time you check the bounty board, you’ll earn the listed coin reward! For every bounty you complete, you get another, so keep completing bounties, and you can really build your booty stores!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/355d5e49c953ff7102e7bf28ff8b23a1a7cb4893.png

Got a bounty you don’t think you’ll complete? Once per day, you can remove a bounty from the board, and will immediately be offered a new one! There’s a huge range of different bounties, that will encourage you to play Paper Pirates in different ways. Happy coin hunting, pirates!

It’s the Captain’s Choice now!
When playing Custom Games, don’t forget that the Events tab lets you change how the events in your game are selected. We’re adding to the modes, by introducing “Captain’s Choice”, to complement Random events and Crew’s Choice events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6df5300a4572d89f981ba7f083e8cb6dba3b83d4.png

When playing with your event selection set to Captain’s Choice, each day an event would occur, the Captain is offered a choice of three events. Can you trust your Captain to share the event selection with the crew? Do you like the events they’re picking? With the Captain holding so much power over the ship, make sure you can trust them, and be ready to throw them overboard at the first sign of suspicion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6548e0ce0d6a84f340ca6bd0800b2b72b28fd074.png

If you’re playing with an audience, the Captain can decline to choose for the day, trusting in fate, and choosing the event the audience picked instead. The Captain doesn’t know what event the audience has picked before choosing it, so it’s a surprise even to them! Will the audience wildcard help or hinder the crew?

A Few Other Things

 Pirates connecting to the lobby of a game that requires players to login with Twitch will now be shown a pop-up encouraging them to login with Twitch to play.
 The Outfit Shop interface has been given a minor facelift to make it easier to see which categories are sold out, and which have limited-time items left to purchase.
 Sam Sherbot has a small number of new items in stock in the Outfit Shop!


Bug Fixes

 The ‘Found Stowaway’ event is now called ‘Found Stowaway’ throughout all the text in game
 Fixed a typographical error in the Wasp Nest event text

notes.title: 2.5.1 Bonus Update
notes.notes:
We’ve got a few little extra updates, features, and bug fixes ready for release a little earlier than usual - so we’re bringing them to you in the 2.5.1 Paper Pirates Bonus Update!

Twitch Integration
At the request of the lovely streamers who have been playing Paper Pirates, we’ve added Twitch Integration to Paper Pirates. If you’d like to ensure that your players are using their Twitch usernames to join your games, enable ‘Require Twitch Login’ from the main menu options before starting your game! Players who aren’t logged in to Twitch will automatically join your audience instead (unless you have Audience Mode turned off, which case they won’t be able to join at all!).

To play with a connected Twitch account, click the Twitch logo in the top-left when connected via your device. Once you’re connected via Twitch, you won’t be able to change your name - so press the Twitch icon again to disconnect your account, and you’ll be able to change your pirate name again.

Kick Pirates from the Lobby/In-Game
Another requested streamer feature is the ability to remove pirates from the lobby and from the game. Where previously you could click on a pirate to mute them, doing so now opens a menu, where you can choose whether to mute a pirate (preventing them from sending messages to the chat) or kick them from your game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e52d03ef5e9a1b86071624d89ebadec4c190b469.png

If you kick a pirate after your game has started, that pirate will be replaced by a bot, and they won’t be able to reconnect.  Please be very careful and be absolutely certain that you want to remove that pirate before kicking them!

Keyboard Menu Navigation, Accessibility Mode and Spoken Room Codes
In our efforts to improve Paper Pirates accessibility, we’ve added a first pass at keyboard navigation to in-game menus, which you can try using the arrow keys.  

Additionally, we’ve introduced an Accessibility Mode, which can be turned on either through the main menu options or by pressing left shift three times. When Accessibility Mode is turned on, spoken prompts will announce which menu option is currently selected. This functionality initially covers the main menus and options screen, and there are some additional spoken prompts during the game to indicate key gameplay elements (e.g. how much treasure is remaining).

Finally, we have added a button to the lobby screen which allows for the room code to be read aloud. This button can also be accessed and selected via the aforementioned keyboard navigation.

The accessibility features are currently very much in testing, and we would greatly appreciate feedback on these via the Paper Pirates Discord, or through the Steam forums.

A Few Other Things

 You can now hover over each pirate’s objective in the round history to see a full description of their secret objective at the end of the game.
 If a pirate ends a Scored Game on the ghost team, the ghost haunting them will now join them on the party podiums to share in the celebrations.


Bug Fixes

 Hats in the ‘new hat unlock' toast were appearing behind the model’s head! Now they aren’t.
 If someone voted for you during a Shroud of Fog event, the little black spots appearing all over your device gave the game away as to who voted for you - oops! They’re now properly obscured by the fog. Spooky!
 When playing a game with event selection set to “Crew’s Choice”, some events were appearing a little too often.
 The ‘Lost at Sea’ Daily Voyage wasn’t correctly activating the Shroud of Fog event when it should’ve been.
 When playing with Crew’s Choice, rarely on days with no audience vote, an audience vote from a previous day could have accidentally been chosen.

notes.title: Victory Update
notes.notes:
As we prepare to say goodbye to the Haunted Seas event, we’re setting sail for destination 2.5! The focus of this patch is improving the Paper Pirates user experience, and hopefully making it so that everyone who plays can get a better understanding of the rules. Don’t be too sad about the end of Haunted Seas - keep an eye on the Steam updates for more seasonal events as they happen!

Celebrate the Winners with an All-New Game End Experience
The game’s not over when you reach the shore or all your treasure’s gone overboard, and we’re recognising that with an all-new, freshly revamped game end experience! New screens and animations add tension as each crew member is revealed to be a human or ghost, and if you made it home safe? Watch out as the captain’s role is dramatically revealed, revealing the winning team to all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/cda33e5b70d65118482d26dbee61388240f1d798.png

If you’re playing a scored game, there’s a second game end screen featuring our party podiums, that show each pirate’s coin total. Watch out for a last-second reversal of fortune as the secret objectives are revealed - especially if you have a Demotivated Stowaway!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a524d8bce54308d7c9599b673b7c6d09d537b71b.png

Pirate Leaderboard
Every time you play a game of Paper Pirates from 2.5 onwards, your player statistics will be saved to your pirate template. Keep using the same pirate name to build up a score over time, and then see how you fare amongst your friends with the new Leaderboard! On the Leaderboard, you can sort by a number of stats (including human wins and ghost wins!) to see who’s truly the most victorious pirate of all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c4bc5beb971b362038513b832ef36882e143feae.png

Player Chat Improvements
We’ve given the in-game chat a little bit of a facelift, to make it more user friendly! The chat history has been separated from the Game Log (which you can still find in the menu), and shows up when you’re sending a message. Additionally, each player is assigned a colour which shows up throughout the game - in their nameplate, in the chat, and during the game end screens! There are ten colours in total, but don’t be fighting amongst yourselves for your favourite colour - they’re randomly chosen each game!

Connected Player Guidance and Graphical Improvements
The connected player client has received a visual overhaul with 2.5, which adds improved guidance throughout the game indicating what you need to do and when. Additionally, there are a host of fun new animations that play at certain points in the game - look out for all the different event animations as you play! If you’d like to reduce your bandwidth usage while playing, or improve client performance, you can turn animations off in the menu after you’ve connected to a game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9fc426aa0ef66bd591c3422bf25cf09ed25aa385.png

The Captain Returns!
For this patch, we’ve coordinated some socially distanced voice recording, and we’re delighted to welcome back Captain Wilson who has topped up the voice acting in Paper Pirates. Once again you can look forward to announcements throughout the game, including the rules introduction, during events, and in the new improved game end screen!

Voting History
During voting, your connected device will now display an indicator of who is currently voting (remember, pirates vote one by one from stowaway to captain!), and a record of who each pirate voted for - or a note to say they passed their vote if they did!

Scurvy
Patch 2.5 sees the introduction of one new event, but it’s sure to really mix up your games! When treasure goes overboard, there’s a chance the Scurvy event might activate, offering a pirate a bowl of fruit. Share the fruit amongst the crew, saving pirates in turn - the question is, is there enough fruit to save everyone…?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e3f6f348e48aa3f7a89afd2412e44678a5b709ec.png

Don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT (adjusted time for the UK’s daylight savings time!) on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our Discord!

notes.title: Seasonal Update
notes.notes:
Storm’s A-comin’!
We’re stoked to be launching the great ship 2.4, bringing general improvements to Paper Pirates, plus a whole new way to play! Play a Daily Voyage each day to boost your coin collection, celebrate the seasons with limited-time content (including the Halloween event running from 1st-31st October!), and check out the new way to pick an objective on a Scored Game. Read on for the notes in full!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87727536e4a622f1e685c6273ac1a4e71480cad0.png
Go on a Daily Voyage!
We’ve added a new game mode to Paper Pirates, the Daily Voyage! Set sail each day with a Daily Voyage, featuring a set of game customisation options that we think makes for a really interesting Paper Pirates experience. Find whole new ways to play, and earn yourself a huge coin bonus once a day! There are over 15 daily voyages for you to discover - can you collect them all?

Celebrate the Season with Paper Pirates!
Support has been added for seasonal events, which will run at key holidays throughout the year! Seasonal events add all-new content for a limited time only - including new options in the Outfit Shop and special Events. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6418d17194a18947996accec9f75beb651a1020d.png
Our first event is the Halloween Haunted Seas Event, running from 1st October to 31st October, with a whole raft of limited-time content. Haunted Seas content will only be available during the month of October, so be sure to get spooky on the seven seas to try out some all-new Paper Pirates goodness!

Choose an Objective & New Objectives!
It’s always rough when you get the same secret objective in a Scored Game over and over again. Starting a Scored Game will now offer all pirates a choice between two of the secret objectives, which you can confirm through the black spot! You only have until the end of the first day to choose an objective, otherwise we’ll pick for you - and nobody wants that!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e03ca5f49922c69d78b8447bef8c2f57703c73ad.png

To keep it fresh, we’ve also added five new secret objectives, bringing the total to 20, ensuring that everyone will be offered unique objectives even in ten player games. Check out the Captain’s Log to learn more about the new objectives.

More Help for the Crew while Playing!
We’ve added a new menu you can access while playing Paper Pirates on your connected device, which houses a whole host of new options intended to make playing Paper Pirates easier and more accessible! The Game Log has moved to live inside the new menu, and joins new friends, including a summary of the Paper Pirates rules, an Event Guide, an Objectives Guide, and a Game Info screen, which lets players know what settings were used to start the game!

Revamped ‘Playing In’ Screen
Choosing whether to obey or disobey has never been so exciting, as the ‘playing in’ screen has had a radical overhaul to improve readability and make it more visually appealing! Additionally, we’ve streamlined the process to make the rules simpler to understand: No longer does the captain tell a Truth or Lie, but chooses to Obey or Disobey - the same as the rest of the crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e46a4e20a9923767c2c7610088e8bb2b60b4cb0c.png

Reveal Role on Vote Overboard
We’ve added a new option to Custom Games, which allows you to set games to ‘Reveal Role on Vote Overboard’. With this setting on, the crew will get confirmation when voting a pirate overboard as to whether the pirate thrown overboard was a human, or a ghost. This can really change the way you have to play, and works great if you have a random number of ghosts at the start of the game! Roles are only confirmed when players are thrown overboard in votes, so watch out for events that throw pirates overboard - they’re still to cause mystery and chaos!

A Few Other Things

 We added four new achievements - which also means four awesome new hats! Check Steam to see how you can get each of these new achievements:
 
 A Voyage a Day
 Seven Seas
 Big Spender
 The Compass of Fate

 We fired the end game kraken, and hired a much more modern, sleeker, more awesome-looking one. This also means the Squid Hat has an amazing new look.


Bug Fixes
Custom Games with a customised event loadout would sometimes miss one of your events out. Oops! They’re all included now, which means games with only one event should again be functional!

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our Discord!

notes.title: Fashionable Update
notes.notes:
Heave ho, mateys, to the Outfit Shop we go!
Put on your best pirate digs, and get ready for the Fashionable Update for Paper Pirates - bringing a hundred new outfit customisation options, which you can unlock by playing games of Paper Pirates, plus a whole new way to choose your events in custom games, and much more! Read on for the full details of everything included in this month’s update!

Earn Coins as you Play!
As you sail the seven seas, you’ll earn coins as a reward. Playing a Default game will grant you a small amount of coins, and playing a Scored game will grant you coins based on the amount of coins earned by each player pirate in the game. Your total coins can be viewed from the title screen - and if you’ve already been playing Scored Games, you might find that you already have some coins saved up from games you’ve played before 2.3!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9bbf9ff85c7143f8eea765197618f46287bedc3f.png

Spend Coins to Unlock New Outfit Customisations!
But what can you do with those coins? You can spend them at the all-new Outfit Shop! Sam Sherbot, the Shopkeep, has opened their brand new Outfit Shop - and is selling 100 new outfit customisation options across all categories! The Outfit Shop lets you try on new pieces, and once purchased, you can access them from the outfit customiser in the lobby before starting your game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a8fe695bc27a933fbe01d80a6218c633eca17790.png

Events? They’re the Crew’s Choice!
Custom Games have a new option under the ‘Events’ tab, which allows you to switch your event selection mode between Random (events selected randomly) and the new Crew’s Choice option. When Crew’s Choice is chosen, each day, every crew member will be offered a selection of possible events, and will vote on the event they’d like to happen. The more votes an event receives, the more likely it is to happen - but the actual event that’s picked is all down to the Compass of Fate! Crew’s Choice adds a whole new way to play, and another opportunity for pirates to get involved in voting and discussion - we love it, and we hope you will too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5467905fe5dc03b54437249135d250199b8cfd19.gif

If you’re playing with an audience, an audience event will be added to the Compass of Fate every day at least one person votes, and could be chosen to really mix things up in your game!

Bot Voting Improvements
Our bots have gotten a little smarter, and will now make more informed decisions when asked to vote in events. They’ll attempt to use any knowledge they have, such as whether they think someone is a confirmed human or ghost, to make decisions in events such as exorcism - so you should hopefully see some more sensible bot plays in games with less human pirates!

Audience Mode Improvements
Pirates who join the audience will experience a newly improved audience flow, which offers more guidance, instructions and explanation on how audience mode interacts with the game. The audience will be able to see which events other audience members voted for, and when you’re not currently voting, there’s a prompt to let you know what the next thing you can do is. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/53bcda9d185dd4f729f85e104a43363b42ccddda.png

Audience members will also have access to the game log from the point they started observing a game, and there’s a new question mark button which offers a quick overview of the rules of Paper Pirates! 

Additionally, audience members will now see in-game when an event is chosen by their votes. Look out for the “Audience’s Choice” badge on the event messages!

A Few Other Things

 Certain elements of the game (such as the lobby) have been given a revised look and feel, to ensure consistency
 Crew in the lobby now have a ‘Ready?’ button they can use to signal that they’ve finished customising their pirate and they’re ready for the game to begin
 Auto-Hide Room Code will now hide the room code in-game, but can be revealed by clicking on the room code cloud
 The maximum length of chat messages has been increased slightly
 Our new shopkeeper, Sam Sherbot, may rarely join you on a voyage as a bot. Look out for them on your trips!


Bug Fixes

 The Immunity event didn’t always present a countdown timer to prompt the Captain to choose quickly, but the timer should now always pop-up
 A few very rare server crashes have been fixed, so hopefully games are more robust!
 Fixed an issue which could cause games to start on days that weren’t numbered 1
 In the lobby, the room code no longer blocks the view of the pirates in the bottom right of the screen


As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more!

notes.title: Timely Update
notes.notes:
Batten down the hatches, crew!
It’s about time we introduce you to Paper Pirates version 2.2 - an adventure of an update that includes a host of new events and achievements, a new game log feature in the device client, and a whole new way to create custom games! Read on for all the details!

Brand New Events!
To keep you on your toes, we’ve added nine new events - and for the first time ever, four of these events are exclusive to the Scored Games variant of Paper Pirates! If you’re looking to complete your events list in the Captain’s Log, make sure you’ve played at least a few scored games to uncover these hidden new events. We don’t want to spoil any surprises, but one of the new events has the potential to completely warp your game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9c2bb4cc56601ef8ee2630b7b8cfcfd1b0fb0dbc.png

More Customisation in Custom Games
Bringing more excitement to Custom Games, you can now include and exclude specific events and secret objectives from each custom game you play! Hate it when a last minute Mutiny disrupts your plans? You can ban the Mutiny event from your game! Wondering what would happen if every pirate was Demotivated? You can include it as the only secret objective in your game! Now your custom games can be as different as your heart desires!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5872184bff3291fb9f122db2c1f62580dab5cc0e.png

Extra Achievements!
With new events and new ways to play custom games, we’re also adding a handful of new achievements - and as always, each new achievement comes with a new hat, which you can unlock as soon as you earn the achievement. If you want to be the most fashionable pirate on the seven seas, track down any of the eight new achievements as quickly as you can, and try out the new hats before yer crew!

The Game Log
Didn’t see who went overboard? Looked away and missed an event? Each connected device now has access to the ‘Game Log’, which tracks all the important going-ons of each game, available to each player during the game. Use the new Game Log button to access it, and you’ll be able to recap whether the job each day was a success or failure - and who played in, which events happened each day and what they did, and who voted to throw a pirate overboard. Additionally, any chat messages sent will be logged in the Game Log too! Great for cross-referencing when someone claimed to be a human with what their actions showed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ec25244b657f58ea2bbed127d24241dd97683fe0.png

Audience Experience Adjustments
We’ve made some general adjustments to the audience experience, for a smoother overall experience. Audience members will now see a short description of each event when choosing which to vote for, and events voted for by the audience should now be slightly more likely to appear too. The audience flow has been adjusted, so audience members need to keep an eye on their devices so they know when to vote!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e090bb9d49e34f7ddef2ec7ecf201ae65bf14436.png

Performance Improvements
We’ve tightened a few things up under the stern, making sure everything’s ship shape and ready for sailing. You may see some general performance improvements, particularly with certain graphics cards and drivers.

A Few Other Things

 We’ve added How To Play guides, accessible from the title screen for both Default and Scored games. Just click the “?” button, and they’ll pop right open, detailing all the rules of Paper Pirates for you to browse!
 Some older events have been given new animations - see if you can spot them all!
 Each day now has a day/night cycle, to help impress upon the crew the passage of time.
 Buttons linking to the Iteration Games Twitter, Discord, Twitch and YouTube communities have been added to the title screen. Please visit us to talk about Paper Pirates, we’d love to hear from you!
 Pirates can no longer join a game using the name of a pirate who is already in the game.


Bug Fixes

 The Just Desserts achievement wasn’t being properly credited, but this is now fixed - Evil Chefs, get your soup at the ready!
 We’ve made the reconnection process a touch more robust, so you should now have a greater chance of reconnecting to a game when you’ve disconnected.


As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more!

notes.title: Portraits Update
notes.notes:
Weigh Anchor and Hoist the Mizzen!
Today, we’re super excited to share Patch 2.1, the Portraits Update, with all you scurvy sea dogs setting sail on the Paper Pirates oceans! This update includes a fancy new feature for makin’ portraits of your pirates, perfect for sharin’ with your mateys. We’ve also got a round of bug fixes and balance changes, to ensure your games play to the pirate code. Check out the patch notes in full just below deck!

The Photo Booth
A new addition to the Captain’s Log, the Photo Booth, let’s you pick from your pirate templates, and prepare a custom snap all ready for sharin’! You can prepare your pirate in a whole range of poses, put them on different backdrops, pick a foil, and even add an adornment - such as a nameplate, a rosette, or some words of wisdom, to make the perfect picture. Hit the save button, and your pirate’s picture will be exported, ready for sharing with all your friends! We’d love to see your best #PiratePortraits, so why not share them with us on Twitter at @IterationGames.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/bf463218cb0a4e8a1e178dfc41c4be18f8efc958.png

Expand your Booth
Looking to add more poses, backgrounds and foils to your photo booth to make the ultimate portrait? It’s now not only hats that you can unlock with achievements, but your photo booth will grow over time as you unlock achievements! Make sure you visit the photo booth when you’ve had a particularly exciting game to see if you have any fancy new decorations for your pirates - you might find a new favourite.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0e532803f3edb6477fda62832ce5f190bb3475cb.png

In-Game Patch Notes
Look out for the “Patch Notes” button from the title screen, to view a quick summary of the latest changes to Paper Pirates in-game. Handy if you need to find out about the latest bug fixes and balance updates before setting sail!

Steam Cloud
A few updates ago, we added pirate templates, so that you can save your pirate appearances for names you use often. Now those appearances will be saved to the Steam Cloud, so they’re all safely backed up, along with some of your preferences, configurations, and stats data - as a bonus, they’ll also travel with you from computer to computer if you play Paper Pirates on multiple PCs!

Menu Improvements
We’ve revisited some of our menu screens to improve the general user experience of Paper Pirates. Our options screens in particular have been revisited, and for the first time you can access some options directly from the lobby - so you no longer have to back out of a game to tweak your settings!

Balance Updates
We’ve been reviewing the way that secret objectives play out in scored games and we’re making a few small adjustments to some secret objectives to ensure that they’re fun and to make sure everyone feels like they have a chance at earning some coins in each game.

Scored Games

 The Pacifistic secret objective has been removed.
 The Diplomatic secret objective has been added! A Diplomatic pirate scores coins based on how many pirates haven’t been thrown overboard at the end of the game - we’re sure that a diplomatic pirate is bound to make an enemy of a ruthless pirate where both objectives appear!
 The Ambitious secret objective has been reworked. Instead of only awarding coins if you end the game as the captain, you now earn a number of coins based on how high your rank is amongst the crew.
 The Zealous and Spiteful secret objectives have been reworked. Instead of only awarding coins if your target pirate ends the game as captain/stowaway, you now earn a number of coins based on how high/low their rank is amongst the crew respectively.
 The number of coins available for completing the Dependent secret objective has been decreased.
 The number of coins available for completing the Ruthless secret objective has been decreased.


Bug Fixes

 Occasionally, pirates with no hat were assigned Blackbeard’s Beard upon starting a game. Pirates with no hat will now remain hatless once the game commences.
 Pirates created in the lobby for a game that is aborted before it’s started will now still be saved as templates.
 Rarely, when a bot foresaw an event through the Magic Lamp event, the event chosen wouldn’t actually take place. It should now always happen - watch out for those Shipwrecks!


As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch (https://www.twitch.tv/iterationgames) for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqi1SJHkkB4a5h9Q-YJjLWQ) to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more!

notes.title: Objectives Update
notes.notes:
Yo ho ho, mateys!
We’re really excited to introduce Paper Pirates 2.0! 

Headline features include fast mode, the Captain’s Log, and perhaps most excitingly, a whole new game mode with an entirely new way to play Paper Pirates! Without further ado, let’s get into the patch notes....

New Game Mode: Scored Games!
Our new game mode completely changes the way that you sail on the seven seas! Paper Pirates is team-based, it’s true, but in a Scored Game, each pirate earns coins depending on how well they play. To unlock scored games, just play one game of Paper Pirates, and then the Scored Game and Custom Game buttons will be available to you in the main menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1218924350fd0e09910f5721e81399181bf4cf68.gif
What do points make? Coins!
In a Scored Game, pirates earn coins depending on how well they play. Vote to throw a ghost overboard as a human? Coins for you! Achieve your victory condition? Coins for you! The more coins you have, the better you’ll rank at the end of the game. Coin totals are hidden until the end of the game, so you never know quite who’s in the lead until the dramatic finale.

Secret Objectives
In a Scored Game, each pirate also has their very own secret objective, earning coins for meeting their objective as they progress through the game. Secret objectives are unique to you, and only displayed on your device, so don’t be sharin’ them with yer crew! Objectives range from trying to finish the game as the captain, to gaining bonus coins every time you throw a targeted pirate overboard, so they’re sure to mix up your usual style. But watch out! One player might be demotivated, earning a bumper crop of coins if they finish the game as the stowaway…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5881701e7ec6ef0c8d7330348db2c437220ff5fb.gif


There are fifteen different objectives, and once you’ve unlocked scored games you can read all about them in the brand-new Captain’s Log. Once you know what they are, you’ll need to look out for any pirates who are behaving suspiciously… Try to achieve your secret objective, but don’t let anyone else get theirs to stay ahead of your crewmates!
Fast Mode
We’ve heard your requests for a fast mode, for those of you who are seasoned sailors. If you’re looking for a speedier game of Paper Pirates, head over to the options screen and enable ‘Fast Mode’. In Fast Mode, fewer dialogue boxes will be displayed, and there’s less time spent waiting for animations. Don’t panic, we’ll still share important information, like when events are happening, so don’t feel like you need to know Paper Pirates inside out before you try it out. You can even turn it on in the middle of a game using the options menu!
Captain’s Log
Lookin’ for info on all the secret workings of Paper Pirates voyages? The new Captain’s Log is for you! It holds the secrets of all the objectives, events, hats and bots in the game. Events won’t show up until you’ve seen them in a game, and hats won’t show up until you’ve unlocked them, so hunt them all down to reveal them in the log!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/41c91709a7af74c69de8a71b775cafd0341cf242.jpg

Emotes
Brimming over with piratey feelings? Your pirates have learnt a whole new way to communicate! When you pop open the chat box, you’ll now see four new emote buttons that will prompt your pirate to express their feelings through the medium of animation. Feeling joyful? Your pirate can cheer with a heart! Feeling surprised? Your pirate can show an exclamation! Why not use emotes in combination with emoji to really show how you’re feeling when your crewmates have turned against you and are all voting to throw you overboard!
Bot Improvements
For those of you who play solo or like to throw in a bot or two for a bigger game, we’ve made improvements to our bots to make them more seaworthy.
Bot AI Improvements
We’ve tweaked our bot AI so that they’re a little smarter. They should now have a better understanding of event outcomes, and identify their vote targets a little more keenly, and may even send a chat message if they find out some secret information! Does that mean it’s a little bit harder to win against the bots? Maybe! Good luck out there pirates, you’ll need it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0612cbb7fd73794b78b847ee182dae299b2a628f.gif

Bot Identities
Each of the bots now has their very own fixed appearance and personality, so you can spend a little bit of time getting to know them. There are eleven bots for you to know and love, and we hope that over time, you’ll welcome them into your games with a hearty yo ho ho! Have a favourite bot? Why not let us know in the comments!
Player Templates
Finding that you’re spending ages in the pirate customiser, setting up the perfect pirate look every time you play? We’re introducing pirate templates! When you customise a pirate, it’ll be bookmarked using your pirate’s name.  Next time you join a game hosted by the same person on the same PC with the same name, you’ll default to the same appearance! Don’t worry, you can still edit it and it'll update the template, so you’re never stuck with the same hat for too long.
Expanded Custom Game Options
When starting a custom game, there are some new options to keep your games fresh. You can choose to play either Paper Pirates Classic, or the brand-new Scored Mode, and all customisation options are available to you whichever you choose. You can now also choose whether to fill your missing spaces with bots or not, perfect if you’re not sure how many pirates are coming aboard! Finally, you can now break the ghost slider apart, and choose a minimum and maximum number of ghosts - that means you’ll get a random number of ghosts in your game! In a random ghosts game, you don’t find out how many ghosts there are at the start, for that added layer of deductive difficulty.
Balance Updates
To keep things fun and fair, and to always meet the pirate code, the following balance changes have been made to events:

 In the Election event, the stowaway is no longer eligible to vote and cannot be elected captain. The captain, on the other hand, is now able to vote!

A Few Other Things

 A small number of new options have been added to the pirate customiser
 Idle on the title screen for long enough, and you might see some of the bots dropping in for a surprise visit!
 The appearance of the aura, indicating how many times a player has played into rounds successfully or unsuccessfully, has been improved
The distance track has been revamped to more clearly indicate your progress

Bug Fixes

 The Stowaway event outcome now displays correctly in the Round History.
 Clicking in the Round History no longer accidentally mutes pirates hiding behind the history window.


Finally, don’t forget, you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on Twitch  for our weekly dev stream. We love when the audience joins in, so please feel free to swing by and play a few games with us!

notes.title: Eventful Update
notes.notes:
Aye aye, Captain!
Version 1.4 of Paper Pirates has just gone live, and dare we say it, this might be our biggest update yet. We’ve added new achievements (and you know what that means - new hats!), added new events, fixed as many bugs as we could find, and added some new features that make sailing the seven seas easier than ever before. Read on for all the details!

Pirates be aware, this update includes some major new content, and as such you may find that older versions of Paper Pirates stop working! Please make sure that you have updated to the latest version through Steam to ensure smooth sailing.
New Events, Event Names and Categories

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8dc7007177f57bdbf4b8b0a9598619c4c705af73.gif

We hear all the time that events are one of your favourite parts of Paper Pirates, but we heard loud and clear that you wanted more of them. So that’s what we did! Not only that, but we’ve revisited the way that events happen, to ensure that every trip is fun and fair, no matter whether ye be pirate or ghost.
Brand New Events
What’s that, MORE events? We’ve added thirteen brand new events to the game, which means there are twice as many events as before! New events include all sorts of pirate adventures - will you find a magic lamp and be granted a vision into the future? Will you take the chance as the Cook to poison the soup of your greatest rival?
Event Titles
Can you never remember which event is which? When an event occurs the dialogue boxes now display the name of the event. We hope that you’ll enjoy getting to know the events, learning their names, befriending them, and building strategies to cope with each one. This also means the audience members know which events they’re voting on, too!
Event Categories
Events now fall into three types - sailing events, treasure events, and wildcard events. This means that if things are going a bit too well for the humans, we’ll try to give you an event that might just save the ghosts! If your ship is starting to look more haunted than shipshape, we’ll get you back on track with an event that’ll make your time at sea a breeze! No matter how bad things look for you, a well-timed event can always turn the tide of the game, so never give up hope!

End of the Game Clarity
Round Summary
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/00a31f9dbc73b24549eb918bede00db1382d92a3.gif

Need to settle an argument between crew members at the end of the game? Nobody willing to own up to being The OG? When you reach the end of a game, you’ll have a new option to view a Round Summary, which shows you what happened on every day of your voyage on the seven seas. You can check who played in (and whether they obeyed or disobeyed!) each day, when everyone was a ghost, and which events happened and when. For the forensic analysts of you, there’s a lot you can learn here about the shady behaviour of your friends. Just don’t spend too long at the end of the game summary before jumping into your next adventure!

Personalised End of Game Screen
Each pirate will now receive an end of game screen on their device, letting them know which victory outcome the crew achieved, and whether they personally won or lost the game. This adds some additional clarity, especially to the stowaway - that’s right stowaways, you always get a little message telling you that you’ve lost! Hard luck this game, but there’s always next time!

Achievements, Hats and Pirate Customisation
There’s nothing a pirate loves more than being fashionable. Well, there’s probably a few things actually, but let’s say being fashionable. To help ensure our pirates are at the peak of their fashion game, we’ve added new hats - and of course, new hats, means new achievements! Whether you’re nearing the completion of your achievement collection, or you’ve only just started, there’s plenty to play for in the Great Hat Race.
New Achievements and New Hats
We’ve added seven  new achievements, ranging from achievements for cleverly using the new events to winning the game as ‘The OG’. Of course, each new achievement also unlocks a new hat, so that means there’s seven new hats available for your pirates to strut their funky stuff in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e468e203d7d4c740efb41a5aa0c285bdd2762524.png
Pirate Customiser
Until now, your pirate’s look was at the whims of fate. Your only trade-off for getting the hat you wanted was sacrificing the amazing hair you had, and you ended up with a moustache you resented. Not anymore! You can now customise your pirate with much more precision by clicking the palette in the top right of your device when connected to a game lobby! Select from any of the outfit options, choose your hat, or go for that double peg-leg!
New Looks
To celebrate the addition of the new outfit customiser we’ve also added even more designs and colour combinations - your pirate has never looked more unique. You can create your very own pirate look, and once you’ve found your favourites, have a pirate look  that is all your very own.

🌊🌊🌊 Emoji Support 🏴‍☠️🏴‍☠️🏴‍☠️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/be0c5d2d5192d714f65419a3d6420e9da0c58b7e.gif

We’ve added 😊 support to 🦜 names and 💭 messages, allowing you to be more 😜 when 🗣 who you think is a 👻! With great 💪 comes great responsibility, so please obey the 🦜 code when naming your ☠ and 💬 with other players! 
New Graphics Options
We also heard some people were asking for the ability to resize the game and toggle between windowed mode and fullscreen, so we added it! You can now find a fullscreen toggle in the main options menu. Not only that, but you can resize the window as you see fit in windowed mode! Nice!

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where audio playback would sometimes end prematurely.
 Fixed a bug where players could sometimes be connected to a game lobby twice.
 Renamed ‘Clear Sailing’ to ‘Plain Sailing’ for clarity and improved messaging.
 The ‘votes needed’ message no longer displays off the top of the screen in games with many pirates.
 The voting threshold line now appears behind the audience count.
 Votes no longer disappear behind the ‘last command’ reminder message.
